suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-1 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Require documented type 2 diabetes mellitus and separately documented chronic kidney disease satisfying accepted chronicity criteria. Where the relationship is represented as diabetes-related CKD, use clinical findings compatible with diabetic kidney disease, including the albuminuria/eGFR pattern and longitudinal course, while evaluating alternative or additional kidney disease when atypical features are present. In the absence of definitive etiologic evidence, describe the phenotype as CKD in a person with type 2 diabetes or presumed diabetic kidney disease, rather than asserting individual causation. Do not relabel transient AKI, an isolated creatinine abnormality, or every CKD diagnosis in a patient with diabetes as diabetic kidney disease. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.

suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-1 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Require documented type 2 diabetes mellitus and separately diagnosed diabetic retinopathy using appropriate ophthalmologic evidence. Do not infer retinopathy from diabetes alone, and do not use this relationship for unrelated retinal disease or visual impairment without a diabetic-retinopathy diagnosis. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
